title: Fruits, vegetables and food

parent.learn: Fruits and vegetables come from plants.
parent.why: Plants make the food we eat. Fruits hold the plant's seeds; vegetables are other parts like roots (carrot), leaves (spinach) or stems.

parent.learn: Some food comes from animals: milk from cows, eggs from hens, honey from bees.
parent.why: This shows food does not come from the shop — the shop only sells what farms produce.
Fruit, vegetables, dal and milk help the body grow strong. Chips, sweets and cola fill you up but give little the body needs.
Dirty water can carry germs that cause illness; clean water keeps the body working.

ask: Name three fruits and three vegetables in our kitchen.
Which vegetable grows under the ground?
Is a samosa healthy food or a treat?
What did you eat for breakfast today?
Which fruit do you like best? What colour is it?

rounds.h: An apple is a fruit — it has seeds inside.
A carrot is a vegetable — it is the root of the plant.

rounds.t: Which fruit is long and yellow?
rounds.h: A banana is long, curved and yellow.

rounds.t: Which fruit is called the king of fruits in India?
rounds.h: The mango is India's national fruit — the king of fruits.

rounds.t: Which one grows under the ground?
rounds.h: Potatoes grow in the soil, under the ground.
Cows (and buffaloes and goats) give milk.
Fruit helps the body grow strong; the others are treats.

rounds.t: Which fruit is green outside, red inside, with black seeds?
rounds.h: A watermelon is green outside and red inside.

rounds.t: Which one is NOT a fruit?
rounds.h: Broccoli is a vegetable — it is the flower part of the plant.
Bees collect nectar from flowers and turn it into honey.

rounds.t: Rice and wheat are grown by…
rounds.h: Farmers grow rice and wheat in their fields.

rounds.t: Which fruit do we peel before eating?
rounds.h: We peel off the banana skin; grapes, strawberries and cherries are eaten with their skin.

rounds.t: Which meal do we eat in the morning?
rounds.h: Breakfast is the first meal of the day.

rounds.t: Why should we drink clean water?
rounds.h: Clean water has no germs, so it keeps us healthy.
